nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Chinese-language documentation for the Self-Agent web chat client (React + Vite), covering quick-start setup, SSE streaming architecture, the event protocol (token/tool_calls/tool_start/tool_result/done/error), production deployment, and configuration. Explicitly references the SSE implementation in src/api.js and the Vite proxy in vite.config.js.
nodes.languageNotes: Written in Chinese (zh-CN). The 'How it works' section documents why fetch + ReadableStream is used instead of native EventSource (POST body requirement) and maps the SSE event types consumed by the chat UI.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Vite HTML entry point for the web client; defines the #root mount node and loads /src/main.jsx as a module script to bootstrap the React application.
nodes.languageNotes: Follows the Vite convention where index.html is the build entry and the referenced module script is bundled by Vite; document lang is zh-CN.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: npm manifest for the self-agent-web client, declaring runtime dependencies (react, react-dom, react-markdown) and Vite 5 dev tooling, with dev/build/preview scripts that drive the Vite bundler.
